# Agents

Where these methods are:

- `session.agents` — `Session.agents`, a `SessionAgents`
- `igni.agents` — `IgniClient.agents`, a `IgniAgents`

Every method here is generated from igni-core's RPC contract; its documentation is igni's own. The examples run inside an `async` function with `igni` an open `IgniClient` and `session` one of its sessions ([Quick start](/docs/sdk/igni-client/quick-start)).

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`session.agents.discard()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/agents#session-agents-discard) | Delete an agent made during this session. |
| [`session.agents.list()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/agents#session-agents-list) | List the agents this session can hand work to. |
| [`session.agents.promote()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/agents#session-agents-promote) | Keep an agent made during this session, as a project or personal agent. |
| [`igni.agents.cancel_run()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/agents#igni-agents-cancel-run) | Stop one sub-agent's run, leaving the rest of the turn going. |

## session.agents.discard()

Delete an agent made during this session.

```python
async def discard(self, name: str) -> DiscardEphemeralResult
```

`name` is the ephemeral agent. Returns `ok` with its `name`;
or `ok: false` with `reason` when it is unknown or not
ephemeral.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | `name` is the ephemeral agent. |

**Returns** [`DiscardEphemeralResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#discardephemeralresult).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `discard_ephemeral_agent`, scope `session`, area `panels`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
discarded = await session.agents.discard("reviewer")
print(discarded.ok, discarded.reason)
```

## session.agents.list()

List the agents this session can hand work to.

```python
async def list(self) -> list[AgentInfo]
```

Takes no arguments. Returns each agent's name, description, tools,
model, MCP servers, tags, system prompt, where it was defined, and
whether it is ephemeral (made during this session, not yet saved).

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `list[`[`AgentInfo`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#agentinfo)`]`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_agent_details`, scope `session`, area `panels`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
for agent_info in await session.agents.list():
    print(agent_info.name, agent_info.can_orchestrate)
```

## session.agents.promote()

Keep an agent made during this session, as a project or personal agent.

```python
async def promote(
    self,
    name: str,
    *,
    target: str | None = None,
) -> PromoteEphemeralResult
```

`name` is the ephemeral agent; `target` is `project` (the
default: the project's agents) or `personal` (the person's own).
Returns `ok` with the agent's `name` and where it was saved
(`dest`); or `ok: false` with `reason` when the agent is
unknown, not ephemeral, or the destination exists.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | `name` is the ephemeral agent; |
| `target` | `str \| None` | `None` | `target` is `project` (the default: the project's agents) or `personal` (the person's own). |

**Returns** [`PromoteEphemeralResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#promoteephemeralresult).

**Access** [`window`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — Through Fleet's gateway every connection stands as igni's window and makes this call. On the desktop only the app's own window does: a program — with the lockfile's token or an approver token — gets `AccessRefused`.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`AccessRefused`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#accessrefused) when this connection does not stand as `window` · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `promote_ephemeral_agent`, scope `session`, area `panels`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
promoted = await session.agents.promote("reviewer")
print(promoted.ok, promoted.dest or promoted.reason)
```

## igni.agents.cancel_run()

Stop one sub-agent's run, leaving the rest of the turn going.

```python
async def cancel_run(self, run_id: str = '') -> CancelAgentRunResult
```

`run_id` is the sub-agent run's id, as its events carry it.
Returns `ok: true` when the run was cancelled, or `ok: false`
with `error` when `run_id` is empty, no such run is running, or
the cancellation failed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | `str` | `''` | `run_id` is the sub-agent run's id, as its events carry it. |

**Returns** [`CancelAgentRunResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#cancelagentrunresult).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `cancel_agent_run`, scope `igni`, area `session`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
answer = await igni.agents.cancel_run("run_42")
if not answer.ok:
    print("not cancelled:", answer.error)
```
